'When this hits a hero, each hero puts a card from their hand on the bottom of their deck and creates a Ponder token.' Identical printed text to .drafts/clear_conscience_red.json / clear_conscience_yellow.json - same shape, slug differs only.

Trigger: TRIGGERED + ON_HIT gated by ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO. An Action - Attack's own ON_HIT is dispatched to the attack card itself, so the trigger rides directly on the card; the gate is mandatory because the generic 'hit' event also fires when the attack damaged an ally/Spectra aura instead of a hero.

'Each hero': PUT_HAND_CARD_BOTTOM handles ONE player per effect (its handler resolves a single hand, effect_types.py:1557-1616), so this is a SELF pair followed by an OPPONENT pair - put-then-token for me, then put-then-token for them - matching the release-note ordering ('beginning with you then moving clockwise') under the two-player reading.

Release note 2 ('heroes will still create a Ponder token even if they do not put a card'): the token is a separate unconditional CREATE_TOKEN, and the put's handler early-returns on an empty hand without touching later effects. The puts are authored MANDATORY ('puts', not 'may') as JSON boolean false - this handler tests truthiness of the raw value (params.get("optional", True)), so the DSL_REFERENCE string "FALSE" would still offer DECLINE and make a mandatory put optional.

CREATE_TOKEN reads token/count|amount/player|controller (effect_types.py:1942+); 'ponder' routes to the auras zone via template subtypes or the AURA_TOKENS fallback (token_meta.py:55); json/tokens/ponder.json exists (END_OF_TURN destroy-self + draw).

Fragment appears in printed_keywords: it fires from the card DB keywords field via build_keyword_triggers and is deliberately NOT authored here - authoring it again would be a defect.
